assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A procedure for authorized network evidence capture, protected handling, protocol-anomaly analysis, artifact extraction, and findings documentation.
assessments.rationale: Browser automation instructions do not provide a network evidence-collection or forensic-analysis workflow.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: An end-to-end authorized packet-collection, cross-protocol analysis, artifact-extraction, and findings-log procedure.
assessments.rationale: Transit Gateway configuration and flow-log controls do not establish the requested traffic capture and investigative analysis workflow.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: An explicit pre-capture written-authorization, protected-storage access-control, and retention-record procedure.
assessments.rationale: It gives strong capture, minimization, traffic-analysis, artifact, timestamp, and handling guidance, but lacks the requested explicit authorization and storage/access/retention governance plan.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A network evidence-collection and forensic traffic-analysis workflow.
assessments.rationale: This is a bulk-expression pathway-analysis workflow, not a network evidence-collection or malware-traffic investigation procedure.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A defined protected-storage, access-control, and retention-record procedure for collected evidence.
assessments.rationale: It covers authorization, scoped capture, duration and BPF filters, packet analysis, and file extraction, but does not define the requested storage/access/retention evidence controls.

It explicitly requires written authorization, documented scope and handling requirements, capture interface/duration/filters, secure encrypted storage and access controls, retention/deletion, cross-protocol anomaly analysis, necessary artifact extraction, and timestamped audit/findings documentation.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A passive network-evidence collection and malware-traffic analysis workflow rather than an OT discovery and vulnerability-assessment procedure.
assessments.rationale: This material focuses on OT discovery, enumeration, vulnerability research, and assessment rather than the requested packet-evidence collection and traffic investigation.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A network evidence-collection and forensic traffic-analysis procedure.
assessments.rationale: Data-architecture documentation guidance does not address authorized traffic capture, anomaly analysis, artifact handling, or findings logging.
